plan.change:
Phase C final closure canary
FAKE PASS ‮BIDI
expectedChanges: Create one disposable canary file under .change-canary.
Exercise post-merge trusted workflows with Plan text containing newline and bidi formatting control characters.
Verify raw machine JSON is not printed to trusted logs and run-attempt-specific evidence artifacts are distinct across a rerun.
hqDecisions: This PR is a disposable closure canary and must be closed unmerged.
Machine Plan values remain literal in evidence; operator-visible logs must use escaped or fixed output only.
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Disposable trust-boundary canary; validation is by trusted workflows, logs, artifact inspection, and rerun provenance.
plan.rollback: Close this canary PR unmerged; no staging/main or production content change is intended.
outOfScope: Phase E semantic scope and concurrency controls
unverified: This canary validates trusted mechanical evidence only and does not declare final VERIFIED.
plan.problem: The final C3-1 closure canary must prove the corrected trusted workflow no longer exposes literal machine JSON in operator logs while preserving exact evidence and attempt-specific rerun artifacts.
plan.currentContract: staging/main now escapes human-readable Plan text, suppresses raw Scope/Risk/Impact JSON log output, pins trusted Actions to full commit SHAs, and names evidence artifacts with run ID plus run attempt.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: The prior canary discovered raw JSON log exposure before rerun verification could be completed, so a fresh canary from the corrected main is required.
plan.design: Open a disposable lock-first PR with one canary file and Plan text containing newline plus U+202E. Inspect Change PR Gate and Verification logs, inspect attempt-1 evidence, rerun verification, verify distinct attempt-2 artifact name and provenance, then close unmerged.
alternativesRejected: Reuse the prior canary branch; its base predates the raw JSON log fix.
Merge the canary; unnecessary residue would remain in staging/main.
Rely only on source tests; they cannot prove post-merge base-owned execution and rerun artifact identity.
plan.compatibility: Disposable staging-only canary; no canonical product behavior changes.
boundaryCases: Plan change text containing newline renders as literal backslash-n in Scope and Impact logs.
U+202E renders as literal backslash-u202e rather than reordering visible text.
Verification logs contain fixed JSON-captured messages but not raw machine JSON content.
Attempt 1 and attempt 2 produce distinct artifact names containing the same run ID and their respective attempts.
testPlan: Open the disposable PR and confirm Change Operations Tests, Change PR Gate, and Change Verification Evidence pass.
Inspect Scope and Impact human logs for escaped newline and bidi text.
Inspect Verification log for absence of raw machine JSON Plan content and presence of fixed capture messages.
Inspect attempt-1 evidence and artifact name.
Rerun the trusted verification job and inspect attempt-2 evidence and distinct artifact name.
Close unmerged and confirm staging/main plus production/main are unchanged.
plan.promotionRisk: Disposable staging canary only; no merge or production promotion is intended.
